subject: Novus integration — temporary account ownership rotation & MAP
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Novus integration — temporary account ownership rotation & MAP

Team,

Quick context: Novus Analytics is ramping a joint integration with our SDK partner path and their initial pilot accounts overlap with several of our channel-assigned ISV targets. They asked to accelerate onboarding and put a single point owner on the integration side while they run the pilot.

Ask: propose we rotate primary ownership of the 6 overlapping accounts to the Alliances team for a 6-week pilot (Sep 13–Oct 25) so Novus has a single contact for technical onboarding and commercial pacing. During that window, AE responsibilities (renewal/forecast) remain with current AEs but day-to-day sequencing and MAP execution would be handled by Alliances.

Attachments: I pushed an updated MAP matrix (Novus_MAP_v3.xlsx) and a one-page Ownership_Rotation_Summary.docx — both attached. Key risks: quota attribution, incentive alignment, and legal redlines on SLA clauses.

Proposed immediate steps:
- Marcus: confirm quota/forecasting impact and whether we need a temporary credit carve-out.
- Marissa: coordinate canary outreach script and kickoff cadence for the pilot accounts.
- Jonas/Olga: review the SLA redlines so we can push a clean first-pass to Novus.

I can send the MAP to Novus with a suggested mutual action plan after we align on the internal mechanics. Thoughts?

Thanks,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Partner Programs, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Novus_MAP_v3.xlsx; Ownership_Rotation_Summary.docx
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novus integration — temporary account ownership rotation & MAP

Mina — thanks for the clear plan. Quick answers:
- Forecast/Quota: We can mark the pipeline as co-owned for the pilot window; AEs keep credit for commit, Alliances gets overlay attribution. Need to inform Finance for commission timing, but a six-week swap shouldn't break comp cycles if we log it as a temporary overlay.
- Credits: Recommend a small deal-prep credit (1–2% of ARR) as a partner success fund — we can confirm with Finance.

I'll sync with Finance and loop back by EOD tomorrow. Marissa — can you prepare the outreach script and attach the proposed cadence?

-marcus
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@novus-analytics.com>, Novus Analytics <partners@novus-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Novus pilot MAP and proposed ownership rotation (pilot proposal)

Elena / Novus team —

Great speaking earlier. As discussed, attaching our proposed mutual action plan and a short ownership summary to make the pilot operational next week. Key points:
- 6-week pilot window (week of Sep 13 start) with Alliances as primary day-to-day owner.
- AEs retain forecast/renewal ownership; Alliances runs onboarding, integration checkpoints, and weekly cadence.
- We propose one weekly 30-min technical sync and one weekly executive check-in (30 mins) during pilot.

Requested from Novus: acceptance of the attached MAP, and confirmation on two SLA requests (response time for critical P1 issues; escalation path). I included a DocuSign link for an accepted MAP + NDA addendum to speed legal.

DocuSign (MAP + NDA addendum): https://docusign.com/embedded?doc=abc123
Drive (supporting docs): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/novus-integration

If Novus is OK, we’ll flip the ownership in our internal systems on Sep 13 and send the kickoff invites.

Best,
Mina

--
Mina Haddad
Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Novus_MAP_v3.xlsx; Ownership_Rotation_Summary.docx
From: Elena Park <elena.park@novus-analytics.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal (Novus) <legal@novus-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2026 11:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Novus pilot MAP and proposed ownership rotation (pilot proposal)

Mina — thanks for the quick turnaround and the MAP. Novus is generally aligned with the pilot and the ownership rotation proposition. A couple items from our side:

- SLA: We can accept the proposed response times for P2/P3 issues, but we need the P1 (critical) response window tightened to 1 hour and an explicit escalation point in your org (we've had outages that required that SLA).
- Commercial: We appreciate the credit idea. Can we formalize a small onboarding credit (they suggested 1.5% ARR) and include it in the MAP?
- Legal: our counsel attached two minor redlines to the NDA addendum and asked for a revised copy before signing.

Forwarded message:
> On Wed, 8 Sep 2026 at 08:45 Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com> wrote:
> > Great speaking earlier. As discussed, attaching our proposed mutual action plan and a short ownership summary to make the pilot operational next week.
> > DocuSign (MAP + NDA addendum): https://docusign.com/embedded?doc=abc123

We can sign once we get the P1 SLA clarification and the NDA redlines addressed. Happy to kick off technical sessions the week of Sep 13 as planned.

-Elena

Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Novus pilot MAP and proposed ownership rotation (pilot proposal)

All — quick summary and next steps so we have this recorded:

1) SLA P1 window: Jonas/Olga — can you confirm we can commit to 1 hour on critical response? If not, propose a compensated SLA (e.g., 1 hour with a small credit if missed).
2) Onboarding credit: Marcus — please confirm Finance ok with 1.5% ARR onboarding credit for pilot accounts; if approved, we will include in the MAP and Finance will track.
3) NDA redlines: Legal has minor redlines — I attached SLA_Redlines.pdf with our suggested response.
4) Internal system change: Marissa — please prepare the temporary owner records (Alliances team) so we can flip on Sep 13.

Public notes/links: HubSpot record https://hubspot.company/contacts/DEAL-18234; Drive folder https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/novus-integration

If we have alignment on the three asks above by Sep 13 EOD, we will proceed with the kickoff on Sep 14 (technical sync) and Sep 15 (exec check-in).

Thanks everyone — this feels like a pragmatic way to deconflict the account overlap while moving the integration forward quickly. Mina

Attachments: SLA_Redlines.pdf
